criteria.criterion: Mixed-version inputs yield snapshot_changed/knowledge_updating; entry/relations/graph/cursor output never silently mixes snapshots.
Cache keys include selected root/project, snapshot, helper/adapter and presentation versions; cache memory/concurrency/lifetime are bounded.
Stale evidence does not erase safe canonical definitions and no read creates publication locks, repairs hashes or builds products.

Interrupted multi-file publication with stable bytes is rejected until existing owner state establishes completion or recovery; malformed or unreadable relevant coordination returns a safe bounded diagnostic.
Read-only coordination brackets materialization and covers missing-to-present lock races; ordinary browsing creates no lock, intent, receipt, repaired source hash or generated output.

verification_steps_verbatim: Inject concurrent selected-file replacement and publication-boundary changes; prove complete view or specific bounded failure with route-refresh semantics.
Test stale source bytes, unchanged-mtime content changes, helper/mapping change and retired snapshot lifecycle; compare protected hashes/timestamps.

Use deterministic barriers with actual publication/recovery helpers on disposable fixtures for active writes, interrupted partial commits with stable digests, missing-lock creation races, relevant versus unrelated transactions and continuous churn. Assert a complete version or specific bounded refusal, never a mixed version.
limitations: Full reader presentation semantic validation must be supplied through validate_view before candidate publication; absent validator refuses nonempty configured mappings.
Actual entry/relationship/graph/cursor wire consumers and route refresh are later integration work; these tests prove immutable coherent source views and expected-snapshot refusal.

The service supervisor must verify its initial bootstrap, full installed package manifest and worker handshake, enforce opaque-operation deadline/RSS, and own sticky package-change session/asset shutdown. Standalone open_store does not prove that entire production lifecycle.

The default tested compiled read closure contains core/modules/validate/snapshot. New package helpers intentionally change the epoch; later integration needs fresh startup and affected current checks.
Actual publisher calls targeted disposable fixtures only. The live-root check compares selected bytes and mtimes across cached reads, not the release-wide preservation manifest or a performance gate.

Standard-library/interpreter runtime is trusted; project modules are compiled from captured verified source without ambient project imports or pyc. Tests directly reject ambient stdlib shadowing and preloaded fake stdlib origins.
Historical failed diagnostic runs remain unchanged and are not current acceptance evidence.
stopping_condition: Bounded snapshot implementation and direct deterministic checks complete; manager acceptance and later full-service integration remain separate.

correction.reason: Manager reproduced raw AttributeError for a selected module manifest whose JSON value was an array.
correction.change: Guard untrusted configuration, optional identity, module manifest, graph and source containers before discovery access; preserve complete canonical loader validation. No blanket AttributeError catch was added.
correction.required_outcome: Exact store.error_type with fixed canonical_invalid message; previous store.current identity unchanged.
